plain: An old word for someone who worships false gods

webster.text: A heathen; a Gentile; an idolater; one who worships false gods.

example.quote: In the first place, he said, there was an invitation for Jews and pagans of every kind to come among us.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. CALDWELL, July 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
